title: Chrome/Chromium UI, menus, toolbar, tab strip, context menus, and settings
scope: Publicly documented browser-chrome defects and usability complaints, including toolbar pinning and the operating-system settings surface for Chrome permissions. Excludes general web rendering, DevTools, security vulnerability hunting, and local build work.

evidenceInterpretation.observedFacts: Issue identities, original descriptions, current status snapshots, components, timestamps, and selected linked changes were read from public primary sources. Source verification is not local reproduction.
evidenceInterpretation.reportedBehavior: Issue steps, expected results, symptoms, affected versions, frequency, and workarounds are attributed to the cited reporter or contributor. All reproduction procedures in this dataset remain unexecuted locally.
evidenceInterpretation.engineeringClaims: Fix and proposed-fix explanations are their authors' assessments. A merged change establishes integration into its stated branch, not successful behavior in every released binary.
evidenceInterpretation.confidence: Confidence concerns the documentary support for the record and its qualifications, not an assertion of hands-on verification.
evidenceInterpretation.statusMethod: Reader-mode extraction returned empty bodies for four initial issue requests. Anonymous HTTP HTML contained original descriptions and current snapshots in defrostedResourcesJspb, which were parsed as data without executing page code. Numeric statuses were decoded using the public tracker client mapping and official status definitions.
